title: Upwind Security Raises $400M to Reach $3.8B Valuation
summary:
The San Francisco based provider of AI and cloud cybersecurity closed a fresh round of financing from investors led by Bessemer to expand its suite of security tools. The $400 million investment brings the startup's valuation to $3.8 billion, up from a $1.5 billion valuation recorded in January.

The new capital raises the total funding for Upwind Security to $830 million. The company focuses on providing protection for cloud applications and artificial intelligence environments.
